name: Prototype Sky Striker Ace – Phantom
effect:
2 monsters, including at least 1 “Sky Striker Ace – Purple Danya”
This card is always treated as “Sky Striker Ace – Purple Danya.”
The first time you Special Summon “Prototype Sky Striker Ace – Phantom” from your Extra Deck, it becomes unaffected by your opponent’s card effects until the end of your next turn.
When this card is Special Summoned: You can negate the effects of all Special Summoned monsters your opponent controls. You can only use this effect of “Prototype Sky Striker Ace – Phantom” once per Duel.
This card gains 500 ATK for each Special Summoned monster on your opponent's field.
